name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime
description: Legacy client-runtime compatibility shim: provides the store primitives (createSnapshotStore, defineStore) that third-party client bundles require from @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime/client, without registering the sessions/workspaces services the real runtime used to own (now owned by the api controllers). See .agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-08-28-legacy-plugin-compat-shims.md.
